mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as liquidity expands.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise above 4.5% signals labor market overheating and impending demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 2200 and 350000 respectively indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) decline below 105.0 indicates manufacturing weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to profit margin pressure.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0 in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 months signals restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity liquidity and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over 6 months indicates expanding consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances where RSAFS rises over 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% for 3 months signals labor market slack, boosting wage growth and consumer spending, which generates positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 and housing starts (HOUST) below 2200.0 indicate broad-based supply contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST fall below thresholds, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year windows.
